headlines.title: MAHA fractures deepen as some RFK Jr. followers turn into harsh critics
headlines.description: A scorecard from MAHA activists suggests the Trump administration has broken most of its promises to the movement. The “burn feels especially raw,” one prominent activist said.

headlines.title: The secret to a good night’s rest? Let sleeping dogs lie — next to you
headlines.description: A surprising new study found that people who sleep near their dogs don’t experience disrupted sleep. If anything we humans are the ones disturbing our dogs’ sleep.

headlines.title: How does hypnotherapy actually work, and what can it treat?
headlines.description: With a wave of TikTok hypnotists promising help with everything from anxiety to weight loss, interest in the practice of hypnotherapy is on the rise. NBC News’ Chloe Melas does a deep dive into the facts and even gets hypnotized herself.

headlines.title: Menopause and Perimenopause: Latest Research and Treatments
headlines.description: Menopause and perimenopause affects millions of women every year, yet they only receive a tiny fraction of federal research funding. But with demand for care on the rise, that longstanding gap in women’s health is starting to close. Board-certified OBGYN Dr. Mary Claire Haver joins TODAY with a checklist of the latest treatments and research findings.

headlines.title: Laura Berman Shares Her Own Journey With Grief in New Book
headlines.description: Relationship therapist and bestselling author Laura Berman opens up about her own journey with grief and healing in her new book “Crying Out Loud,” being published by Maria Shriver’s imprint. In a powerful conversation with Maria, Dr. Berman says she wrote the book after losing her 16-year-old son in 2021 who died after taking a drug he bought on social media.

headlines.title: First New Sunscreen Type in 25 Years Hits US Store Shelves
headlines.description: For the first time in more than 25 years, Americans have a new option when shopping for sunscreen. The FDA-approved bemotrizinol is a skin-protecting chemical available in Europe and other parts of the world and is now hitting US shelves.

headlines.title: 17 best deals from Amazon’s Holiday Beauty Event, according to a beauty editor
headlines.description: We rounded up the best deals on skin care, makeup, hair care and more from Amazon’s Holiday Beauty Event, including favorites from Medicube, Tarte, Clinique and more.

headlines.title: How to watch the 2026 NBA season even if you don’t have cable
headlines.description: Here’s everything you need to know about the 2026 NBA season, including when it starts and where to watch or stream the games.

headlines.title: These weighted stuffed animals are the adult version of a security blanket
headlines.description: According to research, weighted stuffed animals can decrease anxiety and leave you feeling calmer. Here are the best options to shop.

headlines.title: Why are your favorite beauty brands ditching talc?
headlines.description: Regulations on talc in cosmetics have been causing reformulations across beauty products. I spoke to cosmetic chemists and dermatologists about potential safety issues and whether you should shop talc-free.

headlines.title: More Than 1.5 Million Pounds of Meat and Poultry Recalled Nationwide. See the Full List
headlines.description: More than a million pounds of meat and poultry have been recalled. The recall affects sausages, hot dogs, bacon and deli meats that were sold across the U.S.

headlines.title: Selena Gomez Says Vaping Is the Reason Her Voice Is Different. What Do Doctors Say?
headlines.description: Selena Gomez has shared that vaping has changed her voice and warned against nicotine use. Here’s how vaping can affect the vocal cords and cause other health problems.
